/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import uno, time, os, sys
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue
# The com.sun.star import may not be available in this Python build; use uno structs instead.

def prop(name, value):
    p = uno.createUnoStruct('com.sun.star.beans.PropertyValue')
    p.Name = name
    p.Value = value
    return p

local_ctx = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = local_ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
ctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
smgr = ctx.ServiceManager
desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
url = uno.systemPathToFileUrl('/home/user/BoomerangSales.xlsx')
doc = desktop.loadComponentFromURL(url, '_blank', 0, (prop('Hidden', True),))
if doc is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Could not open workbook')
try:
    sheet = doc.Sheets.getByIndex(0)
    cursor = sheet.createCursor()
    cursor.gotoEndOfUsedArea(True)
    used = cursor.RangeAddress
    start_col, start_row, end_col, end_row = 0, 0, used.EndColumn, used.EndRow
    if end_col < 4 or end_row < 1:
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected used range')

    data_range = sheet.getCellRangeByPosition(start_col, start_row, end_col, end_row)
    desc = list(data_range.createSortDescriptor())
    sort_field = uno.createUnoStruct('com.sun.star.table.TableSortField')
    sort_field.Field = 0
    sort_field.IsAscending = True
    sort_field.IsCaseSensitive = False
    for p in desc:
        if p.Name == 'ContainsHeader':
            p.Value = True
        elif p.Name == 'SortFields':
            p.Value = (sort_field,)
        elif p.Name == 'IsSortColumns':
            p.Value = False
    data_range.Sort(tuple(desc))

    # Recompute used range after sorting, then chart Date Time (A) against Quantity (E).
    cursor = sheet.createCursor()
    cursor.gotoEndOfUsedArea(True)
    used = cursor.RangeAddress
    last_row = used.EndRow

    charts = sheet.Charts
    chart_name = 'Quantity by Date Time'
    if charts.hasByName(chart_name):
        charts.removeByName(chart_name)

    addr_dates = uno.createUnoStruct('com.sun.star.table.CellRangeAddress')
    addr_dates.Sheet = 0; addr_dates.StartColumn = 0; addr_dates.StartRow = 0; addr_dates.EndColumn = 0; addr_dates.EndRow = last_row
    addr_qty = uno.createUnoStruct('com.sun.star.table.CellRangeAddress')
    addr_qty.Sheet = 0; addr_qty.StartColumn = 4; addr_qty.StartRow = 0; addr_qty.EndColumn = 4; addr_qty.EndRow = last_row

    rect = uno.createUnoStruct('com.sun.star.awt.Rectangle')
    rect.X = 12500
    rect.Y = 1200
    rect.Width = 17500
    rect.Height = 10000
    charts.addNewByName(chart_name, rect, (addr_dates, addr_qty), True, False)
    chart_obj = charts.getByName(chart_name).EmbeddedObject
    chart_obj.Diagram = chart_obj.createInstance('com.sun.star.chart.LineDiagram')
    chart_obj.HasMainTitle = True
    chart_obj.Title.String = 'Quantity by Date Time'
    chart_obj.Diagram.HasXAxisTitle = True
    chart_obj.Diagram.XAxisTitle.String = 'Date Time'
    chart_obj.Diagram.HasYAxisTitle = True
    chart_obj.Diagram.YAxisTitle.String = 'Quantity'
    chart_obj.Diagram.HasLegend = False

    # Save in-place as the original XLSX.
    doc.store()
    first_dates = [sheet.getCellByPosition(0, r).String for r in range(1, min(last_row + 1, 6))]
    print('saved; first sorted Date Time values:', first_dates)
finally:
    doc.close(True)
PY"
